body_html:
"Realization comes from constant, deep meditation and from the every-busy, ever -searching effort to convert theory, through practice, into useful knowledge."

"Lift
your consciousness
from the confining
noisy world
of matter
into the
vastness
of
silence"
Paramahansa Yogananda
